title: Birsalma-fagylalt (Quince Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with quinces, juice, and sugar.
steps: Peel 4 large ripe quinces and cut into thin slices
Cook in a preserving pan with 42 dekagrams sugar and 7 deciliters fresh water until the quince is completely soft
Cool and press through clean, thin kitchen cloth
Mix with the juice of 2 lemons
Cool completely
Pour into freezing container and proceed as with other ice creams
The same mixture is used to make jelly, but for that use one and one-quarter dekagrams of dissolved isinglass, and strain as with all jellies through kitchen cloth and blotting paper

title: Birsalma-kocsonya (Quince Jelly)
description: Prepared with quinces, lemons, and isinglass.

ingredients.name: 4 large ripe and beautiful yellow quinces
ingredients.sourceText: 4 large ripe and beautiful yellow quinces

steps: Cook the sugar in water only until it dissolves
Wipe the four large ripe and beautiful yellow quinces clean with a cloth, but do not peel them
Cut them into slices as thick as a knife blade and cook them in the sugar until soft
When the sugar has well absorbed the quince flavor and the color is beautiful yellow, strain through a sieve but do not press
Press in the juice of two lemons
Mix in the dissolved isinglass
Strain through a stretched cloth
If it is beautifully clear, pour into a mold and freeze on ice
Alternatively, thin slices of quince preserved in sugar may be placed in the jelly in two or three rows, and then treated as other layered jellies

description: Prepared with quinces, water, and sugar.
steps: Bring the quinces to a slight boil in water, then place them in cold water

Arrange on a serving dish and pour the light syrup over them

title: Birsalma-ostya (Quince Wafer)
description: Prepared with quince, quinces, and lemon juice.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagramm sugar rubbed with lemon zest
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagramm sugar rubbed with lemon zest

steps: Scald beautiful ripe quinces with skin in water until softened
Peel and scrape the flesh with a knife without including the hard core
Mix finely 32 dekagramm of the scraped pulp strained through a sieve with 28 dekagramm sugar rubbed on lemon zest, adding the juice of 1 lemon
Spread very thinly on small porcelain plates coated with butter
Place the plates in a warm oven until the mixture dries enough to be pulled off
Roll onto round wooden sticks prepared for this
Brush the end with egg white so they stay together
Dry in a warm oven
Note: when rolling, the part of the wafer that lay on the buttered plate forms the outer side

title: Birsalma-pép (Quince Paste)
description: Prepared with quinces, egg whites, and sugar.
steps: Cook the quinces until soft
Peel them and pass through a sieve
Place in a bowl and cool
When cooled, add the finely ground sugar and stir for a quarter hour
Slowly fold in the stiffly whipped egg whites
Pour the mixture into a buttered porcelain mold
Mound it into a cone shape with a wide knife
Make six indentations
Set in a water bath and cook for half an hour
Note: Do not place a metal cover on top, as the paste would burn

Moisten the grated rolls with the heavy cream

title: Birsalma-Rudacskák (Quince Sticks)
description: Prepared with quinces, ground almonds, and citron.

Peel and pass the flesh through a sieve
Take equal weights of sugar to quince pulp
Cook the sugar with a glass of water until very thick and forming large bubbles

Spread the mixture onto the strips with a wet knife to the thickness of a little finger
Place on wax-coated baking sheets
Leave in a cooled oven until dried and easily peeled off
Coat with lemon preserve

title: Birsalma-Sajt (Quince Paste)
description: Prepared with quinces, water, and sugar.

ingredients.name: sugar, same amount as quince, half kilogram
ingredients.sourceText: sugar, same amount as quince, half kilogram

steps: Cook or bake seven large ripe quinces until soft; be careful they do not crack as they will then become watery.
When soft, cool slightly on a plate; then peel with a silver spoon, as they would darken from a knife, and press through a sieve.

For half a kilogram of quince use the same amount of sugar; cook this with one glass of water until it threads, then add the pressed quince, mix well with the sugar, and cook over gentle charcoal heat until the syrup separates from the silver spoon with which you must stir continuously so it does not burn.
Then while still warm place on coffee trays, spread nicely with a spoon, and leave on the tray for five or six days.
Then turn out onto a clean plate, let stand for six to eight days, turning over daily so it dries on all sides. The longer it stands, the better.

title: Birsalma-torta (Quince Cake)
description: A cake made with quince, almonds, and citron.

ingredients.name: 18 dekagramm swollen and finely broken almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 18 dekagramm swollen and finely broken almonds

ingredients.name: 1 lemon, zest and juice finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: 1 lemon, zest and juice finely chopped

steps: Cook 0.5 kilogramm of sugar with 2 deciliter of water in a brass bowl until it threads and produces large bubbles.
Prepare 0.5 kilogramm of pulp from well-ripened quinces, cook it, and press through a sieve.
Add the pulp to the well-cooked sugar, along with 18 dekagramm of swollen and finely broken almonds, 10 dekagramm of chopped citron, and the finely chopped zest and juice of 1 lemon.
Cook together over gentle heat with constant stirring until it becomes jelly-like.
Line a cake layer with large round wafers and spread the mixture to a two-finger height with a knife dipped in water, smoothing it evenly.
Sprinkle with coarsely broken sugar and leave in a cooled oven for 24 hours.
Coat with lemon icing and decorate the edge with Spanish pastries fastened with hardened sugar and green preserved fruits.

For the lemon icing: prepare it as pistachio icing, but rub the sugar on the lemon zest, finely crush it, and when the icing is well worked and clear and thick, incorporate the rubbed sugar and 2 teaspoons of lemon juice, stirring well.
Test the icing by placing a few drops on paper; if it does not spread and becomes firm in a few moments so it can be lifted off intact, it is good; if not, continue working it longer.

title: Birsalmaszeletet Befőzni (Preserved Quince Slices)
description: Prepared with quince, sugar, and water.

ingredients.name: sugar equal in weight to the quince
ingredients.sourceText: sugar equal in weight to the quince

steps: Cut the whole ripe peeled quince into four pieces, or six if larger. Cut off the core. In a preserving basin, cook sugar equal in weight to the quince with four deciliters of water until the sugar dissolves. Add the quince slices and, turning them frequently, cook until completely soft but not falling apart. While the sugar is dissolving, the quince slices must lie in warm water to stay beautiful white in color. Remove the slices and continue cooking the liquid until it begins to thicken. Remove from heat, return the slices to the basin, and shake it strongly so the liquid covers everything. Cool slightly and pour while warm into clean preserving jars, leaving to stand for twenty-four hours. The liquid must completely cover the slices after settling. If the liquid is not thick enough after complete cooling, strain it slowly, cook it again, and pour it warm over the slices.

title: Blaskovics-vesepecsenye (Blaskovics Kidney Roast)
description: Prepared with kidney, vegetables, and bay leaves.
steps: Lard a nice rested kidney roast, salt it, and set aside
Melt 20 deka butter in a pan, slice mixed vegetables into rings and place in the butter
Place the kidney roast on top, cover and braise until the vegetables turn yellow

When this has happened, add among the vegetables three bay leaves, the zest of one whole lemon, one ginger root, and a little whole black pepper, and pour in {{source-8}} mixed with water and braise until the kidney roast becomes tender; if the broth becomes too thick, a little wine can be added
When the meat is tender enough, remove it, strain the broth through a sieve and pour it over the meat

When this has happened, add among the vegetables three bay leaves, the zest of one whole lemon, one ginger root, and a little whole black pepper, and pour in 1/2 liter red wine mixed with water and braise until the kidney roast becomes tender; if the broth becomes too thick, a little wine can be added

steps: Lard the beef with pieces of ham and bacon
Prepare a mixture of minced green parsley, minced onion, several minced mushrooms, salt, and pepper
Roll the bacon pieces in this mixture and insert into the beef
Place the beef in a pot that is not much larger than necessary
Line the bottom of the pot with bacon slices, sliced red onion, and sliced carrot
Place the beef on top, cover tightly, and braise slowly for four hours, turning frequently to prevent burning
Pour four deciliters of white wine and the same amount of good broth over the meat
Continue braising until the meat is tender enough, strain the sauce through a sieve, and pour over the meat on the platter
This dish can also be served cold

description: A cake made with veal, mushrooms, and potatoes.
steps: Prepare a light butter sauce

Cut cartilage boiled in salted water into similar pieces

Mix in one whole egg white beaten to stiff peaks and salt
Fill buttered cake molds, lined with fine breadcrumbs, half full with the beaten potato
Place the chopped meat mixture in the center and top with more potato
Bake at low heat

title: Borjú-láb és fej tojással (Veal Leg and Head with Egg)
description: Prepared with veal, sour cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Put the nicely cleaned veal legs and head to cook in {{source-2}} for one hour.
Remove from broth and remove all bones from the meat.
Place back in the broth and season with salt and pepper, bring to boil again.
Meanwhile prepare a liaison in a deep bowl for one head and four legs: take 2 decilitres good sour cream and 4 egg yolks, 1 good spoonful flour.
Mix well so it is not lumpy.
Slowly pour the hot meat broth into the liaison in the bowl with continuous stirring.
Once incorporated, pour back into the warm pot, remove from strong heat as the egg will curdle.
At serving time squeeze the juice of 2 whole lemons into it, but not before as it would become bitter.
Serve in deep bowl.

steps: Wash and salt a medium-sized veal leg.
Cut already cooked smoked tongue and a little marrow into long pieces.
Make holes with a narrow knife and lard alternately with tongue or marrow.
Line a pan with butter, place red onion head studded with cloves, half lemon rind and its juice in it.
Place the leg on top, pour 3 decilitres wine and 2 decilitres broth over it.

When completely braised and crumbly, chop 3-4 decagrams capers.
Place the leg in another pan, strain the sauce over it and add the capers mixed with a few spoonfuls of sour cream.
Braise a little more, place the leg on dish and pour the sauce over it.

title: Borkő-eczet (Tartar Vinegar)
description: Prepared with vinegar, alcohol, and wine.
steps: Prepare two small wooden barrels made of beech or oak wood with iron hoops
On the front side of the first barrel, above the tap, make an opening 3-4 centimeters from the barrel rim to serve as an air hole, with a diameter of 1½ centimeters
Place both barrels in a cellar that can be kept warm in winter
Fill the first barrel with good vinegar up to the air hole (approximately 7 liters)
Let the barrel rest for 14 days so the vinegar penetrates the wood well
Draw off 2 liters and place in the second barrel, replacing it with boiling water to which 42 dekagrams of alcohol are added
Every 3 weeks, draw off 2 liters and pour into the vinegar reserve in the other barrel, replacing with boiling water and alcohol in the same manner
If you wish to make this vinegar entirely equal to wine vinegar, dissolve a small amount of wine tartrate in it and color it with burnt sugar or raspberry

title: Braised Kale with Rice and Ham (Párolt Kelkáposzta Rizszsel és Sonkával)
description: Prepared with kale, bacon, and ham.
steps: Wash a beautiful firm head of kale cleanly and boil in salted water for a few minutes without making it too soft
Strain and place on a sieve
In a larger pot put several bacon slices, the same amount of ham slices, chopped red onion and carrot, eight peppercorns and five clove-peppers
Cut the kale lengthwise in half and place it cut-side down in the pot
Cover and braise slowly, occasionally pouring a little brown broth on it so it does not burn
When the vegetable has a nice light-brown color on the bottom of the pot, carefully remove the kale
Mix a spoonful of sour cream with it and brown it with frequent stirring
Thin it with good beef broth and cook for a few more minutes until soft but not falling apart
Remove and set aside
Prepare the braised rice: soften ten decagrams of cleaned rice in warm water half an hour before use
Melt a piece of butter or goose fat and add the drained rice to it

Put half a red onion, a few peppercorns and salt in the middle of the rice and braise slowly, occasionally pouring one or two spoonfuls of good broth over it so the rice braises but does not boil, keeping the grains beautiful, white and whole while becoming soft without becoming soupy
Cover the bottom of a pot buttered with a paper that fits exactly
Cut thin slices from beautiful ham and leave a narrow strip of bacon on it
Cut the ham slices into triangular pieces and arrange them on the bottom of the pot so no space remains and the triangles fit together well
Finely chop a piece of lean ham
Remove the red onion and peppercorns from the braised rice
With a spoon, layer the rice smoothly and firmly in the pot, sprinkle thickly with chopped ham, then rice again and so on until the pot is full
Cover and steam for three-quarters of an hour
Before serving, strain the sauce in which the kale braised and let it braise a little
Carefully turn the kale out onto the plate, pour a little sauce on the bottom of the plate and serve with a beautifully prepared veal carbonade

title: Buktatott Kalarábi Töltve (Layered Stuffed Kohlrabi)
description: Prepared with sour cream, filling, and tongue.
steps: Cook the kohlrabi in salted water after peeling and salting it until it begins to soften slightly
Drain and cut into slices of knife-thickness width
Melt butter in a pan, quickly mix with a good spoonful of fresh sour cream
Add the chopped kohlrabi and braise for a quarter hour with frequent shaking
Keep the kohlrabi pale by braising on low heat
Prepare a good filling as needed for stuffed kohlrabi
Coat the bottom of a buttered pan alternately with a layer of kohlrabi and an equal-sized piece of finely chopped and cooked pickled tongue
When the first row is neatly arranged on the bottom, spread the filling smoothly over it
Add another row of braised kohlrabi slices, but without pickled tongue this time
Then add filling again and continue this way until everything is used
Beat three egg yolks with a coffee cup of thin sour cream and a little salt until well mixed
Pour this mixture over the kohlrabi and steam for one hour
At serving time, turn out onto a dish and pour good butter sauce underneath, which contains finely peeled and chopped kohlrabi cooked in it
Border the edges with pickled tongue

title: Buktatott Tojás (Filled Hard-Boiled Eggs with Crayfish and Fish)
description: Prepared with eggs, crayfish, and bread.
steps: Cut 6 hard-boiled eggs in half lengthwise
Place in a mortar: chopped crayfish tails, grated milk-soaked bread, 1 whole egg, {{source-4}}, salt, and a small piece of crayfish butter

Place the filled eggs in the dish
Top with the remaining half of the filling

Place in the oven and let heat through

title: Bukó Kácsa Sülve (Roast Wild Duck)
description: Prepared with duck, marinade, and cream.
steps: Pluck and singe the duck lightly, then clean thoroughly.
Remove the entrails, salt well, and if weather permits, marinate for one day.
Lard the duck and roast until golden-brown, basting frequently with the marinade and cream.
When roasted, finely chop the duck's liver and mix it into a roux made from melted butter and flour.
Add a few spoonfuls of the marinade and juice that dripped from the duck during roasting, along with two spoonfuls of cream.
Add capers and pour this sauce over the duck when serving.

description: Prepared with meat, potatoes, and lard.

Put a little lard and the finely chopped red onion in a pan, add the roasted meat, and stew until tender, turning frequently
Once tender, remove and cut into equal oblong pieces
Return to the pan, add two deciliters of sour cream and stew a while longer

Grease a dish with butter or other fat, add a little sour cream
Layer the stewed roasted meat and onion that cooked with it, then a row of potatoes, then roasted meat again, and continue alternating until all ingredients are used
Top with sour cream and several pieces of butter, sprinkle with breadcrumbs
Place coals above and below so it browns nicely

title: Burgonya-rétes (Potato Strudel)
description: Prepared with potato, egg yolks, and almond.
steps: Cook and cool the potato, then grate eighteen dekagramm potato
Beat 14 dekagramm butter until fluffy
Add the potato to it
Mix in six egg yolks, 7 dekagramm finely ground almond, 10 dekagramm crushed sugar, finely chopped peel of one lemon, and finally fold in the stiffly beaten whites of three eggs
Stir everything together for half an hour
Stretch the strudel dough finely and spread the filling on it
Spread it to the thickness of a knife blade
Fold it together gently
Brush with butter and place in the oven to bake until golden
Note: this strudel must be served immediately after baking so it does not collapse

title: Burgonya-torta (Potato Cake)
description: A cake made with potatoes, ground almonds, and orange.

ingredients.name: 10 dekagramm softened and finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 10 dekagramm softened and finely ground almonds

steps: Cook and cool the best kind of floury potatoes and grate 24 dekagramm of them
Mix in a bowl with finely ground sugar, a little vanilla, softened and finely ground almonds, and finely chopped orange zest
Beat in 4 whole eggs and 8 egg yolks one after another, stirring continuously for half an hour until the mixture grows and becomes foamy
Meanwhile grease three equal cake sheets with the hoops together with butter
Fill the mixture in three equal parts and bake to a nice light brown
Remove from the sheet, place on a sieve and cool
Fill two sheets with preserves of your choice, stack them evenly and decorate the top sheet as desired
Note: this cake must be prepared on the day it will be used, as it dries quickly

title: Burgonyaleves húsnapon (Potato Soup on Meat Day)
description: A soup made with potatoes, broth, and fat.
steps: Cook 3 medium-sized potatoes in 1 liter of broth and after cooling and peeling, grate them.
Cut half a roll into larger slices and fry them until crispy in hot fat, but not brown.

Place in a pot and thin with broth, cooking for one hour.
Pass the whole mixture through a sieve and arrange on fried potato dumplings and marrow cubes the size of forints.

title: Bélés (Layered Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with puff pastry, fat, and rice.

ingredients.name: good puff pastry (made into 24 egg-sized pieces)
ingredients.sourceText: good puff pastry (made into 24 egg-sized pieces)

steps: Divide good puff pastry into pieces the size of 24 eggs
Place two buttered baking sheets side by side, which will make the dough larger
Roll out the first piece of dough over these two sheets and brush with fat
Roll out seven more sheets of dough on top, so the bottom of the dough consists of eight such layers, each brushed separately with fat
Prepare the filling as follows: soak fourteen dekagrams of rice in milk, strain through a sieve so all moisture drains off, place this on the dough, adding small and large raisins
After sprinkling this with sugar and a little broken cinnamon, place eight more sheets of dough on top, each brushed separately with fat
Then comes the filling again prepared in the above manner, and on top, like before, eight more sheets of remaining dough

Trim the dough scraps protruding from the edge of the pan with a rolling pin or knife, cut the dough itself into cubes with a pastry wheel, brush the top with fat, bake over gentle heat and serve dusted with sugar
Bélés can also be filled with cheese or apples

description: Prepared with veal, fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: 1 bread roll, grated crust, soaked in milk and wrung out

Prepare a soft batter from 3 eggs, a small piece of butter, and milk

Prepare a filling from cooked veal sweetbreads and udder, and fricassee this with 2 egg yolks and lemon juice
Prepare crumbly pastry and line a pâté dish and its bottom with it to one small finger's thickness

Roll finger-thickness strips from the remaining dough and arrange them like a grill over the filling so the filling shows through everywhere

title: Búzavirág-eczet (Wheat Flower Vinegar)
description: Prepared with vinegar.
steps: When the flower is in full bloom, carefully pull off the petals, remove the white part, and let it dry.
Place it in a glass bottle, pour good vinegar over it, bind it well, and set it in the sun or in a warm place.

When the wheat flower begins to turn white in the vinegar, place fresh petals, pulled off just as carefully, in another bottle, strain the vinegar from the first flower onto it, and pour fresh vinegar on, bind the bottle, and similarly set it in a warm place.
Continue in this manner with fresh flowers until the vinegar has the desired color.
If you use good strong vinegar for this, not only will the color be much more beautiful, but you will need to pour it onto fresh flowers only two or three times instead of more.

Finely cut lengthwise 7 dekagrams of candied citron, the same amount of almond, and 3 dekagrams of pistachio
Break up 14 dekagrams of sugar finely; place half in a bowl and add the finely ground almond to it
Mix the other half of the sugar with the chopped mixture
Beat 1 whole egg and 3 egg yolks onto this until well and foamy
Roll out the butter pastry to knife-thickness
Fill the molds (kádka) with it
Place some of the chopped mixture in each mold
Pour the egg mixture over as a covering instead of a lid
Bake in a cooled oven

title: Coffee Aspic with Cream (Kávé-kocsonya tejszínnel)
description: Prepared with coffee, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Strain the coffee as cleanly as possible.
Mix the coffee with an equal amount of good cream.
In a pan, thoroughly beat together 6 egg yolks and 14 dekagrams finely ground sugar.
Add the mixed coffee to the eggs and sugar.
Place the pan on charcoal fire and stir constantly until it begins to thicken.
Remove immediately from heat to prevent curdling and pour into a clean pan.
Mix in 2 dekagrams dissolved isinglass.
Stir until cooled, then pour into molds where it remains until use.
Unmold as with other aspics.

title: Coffee Pastry (Kávés-fánk)
description: Prepared with sour cream, roasted coffee, and egg yolks.
steps: Pour the hot roasted coffee into the hot sour cream, cover and let stand for half an hour, then strain and cool
Mix finely with 6 spoonfuls of fine flour and 7 egg yolks
While continuously stirring cook it to a paste and add enough sugar to sweeten it well
When well cooked, remove from heat and cool
Spread the paste onto two large torte leaves greased with butter to a thickness of two knife-widths and cool completely
Place the torte leaves on the cooktop for a few minutes so the butter melts
Turn the paste out onto a floured board and cut out with medium-sized pastry cutters
Dip in beaten egg, coat with breadcrumbs and fry in hot lard until golden
Coat thickly with sugar and press with a hot spatula
Can be prepared the same way with chocolate, cooking 5 bars of chocolate in 7 deciliters of sour cream and treating it the same as the coffee pastry

title: Cologne Water
description: Prepared with alcohol, lemon oil, and orange.
steps: Mix rosemary extract with mint extract with continuous shaking
Add {{source-2}}
Let stand for several hours after stirring well
In a bottle, mix 3.5 kilogram purified concentrated alcohol with 38 dekagrams lemon oil and 8 grams rosemary oil
After several hours, unite this mixture with the first one by continuous strong mixing
Let entire mixture stand for twenty-four hours
Add 3.5 kilogram alcohol and 8 grams rosemary oil and drop in {{source-8}} with continuous stirring
Shake mixture for about fifteen minutes
Let stand for thirty-six hours, shaking for fifteen minutes every twelve hours

title: Crayfish Sausage (Rák-kolbászka)
description: Prepared with asparagus, mushrooms, and pike.
steps: Bake a common egg pancake and when cooled, cut each piece into several parts so the sausages will be finger-length
From blanched asparagus heads, braised mushrooms, shredded pike, and pike liver (which has been fried first), prepare a filling
Melt a piece of crayfish butter, add a little flour and the chopped filling
Braise slightly, then add 1 egg and 1 egg yolk
Mix well, remove from heat quickly and cool
Spread onto the divided egg pancake pieces to a knife-width thickness
Roll up and arrange nicely in a buttered baking dish
Half an hour before serving, beat 4 egg yolks and 4 deciliters of sour cream together
Pour over and cook in a water bath

title: Csiga-rétes (Spiral Strudel - Old Transylvanian Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with dough, plum, and fat.
steps: Stretch the ordinarily prepared thin strudel dough and fold it into four layers
Grease each layer slightly with fat
On the edge of the folded dough lying on the cloth, spread plum preserve very thinly and about half a finger's breadth wide using a knife
Fold the plum preserve-lined band onto the empty dough narrowly and cut with a knife so that you create one finger-width wide, plum preserve-filled dough strips from the entire large strudel dough
Once finished, cut the long plum preserve-filled dough strips into one span-length pieces
Form them into S-shaped, small spiral strudels
Put one spoonful of fat into a flat pan and place over high heat
When the fat is hot, fill the pan with spiral strudels
Watch carefully during baking as this fine dry dough browns very quickly
Transfer to a flat plate and serve without sugar; anyone who wishes can sprinkle sugar on their own

title: Csipkebogyót Befőzni (Preserved Rose Hips)
description: Prepared with rose hips, sugar, and water.

ingredients.name: ripe but not soft rose hips
ingredients.sourceText: ripe but not soft rose hips

steps: Select rose hips when completely ripe but not yet soft. Cut them in half and carefully scrape away the coarse inner part with a knife. Place in a pot that has already been boiled out. Pour enough water so they do not burn. Cook over gentle heat with continuous stirring until all the water has evaporated and the rose hips are soft, then press through a fine sieve. For seventy dekagrams of rose hips, take fifty-six dekagrams of sugar and cook it with two deciliters of water until it threads. Stir in the rose hip pulp and cook with continuous stirring for ten minutes, then pour hot into jars.

title: Csirke forrázva (Braised Chicken in Vinegar Sauce)
description: A sauce made with vinegar, chickens, and onions.
steps: Select small meaty young chickens and prepare them, then blanch them.
Season lightly with salt and prepare them nicely.
Place in a pot with red onions, yellow carrots, green parsley, a little pepper, and a few cloves.

Simmer until half cooked.
In the meantime, brown two spoonfuls of flour in hot butter, then strain the sauce over it.
Add two or three spoonfuls of sour cream.
Return the chickens to the pot and cook until completely tender.

title: Csirke tejfellel és citrom-szeletekkel (Chicken with Sour Cream and Lemon Slices)
description: Prepared with sour cream, lemon, and chickens.
steps: Blanch two small chickens and rinse them several times with warm water.
Cut into the usual pieces and salt them, then let them rest in the salt for a quarter hour.
Pour good sour cream into a pot.
Cut a soup lemon thinly with its peel, carefully removing the seeds.
Layer half the lemon slices in the sour cream, then half the chicken pieces, then more sour cream.
Add the remaining lemon slices, then the rest of the chicken.
Top with sour cream and small pieces of butter.
Note: do not stir these chickens, only shake the pot gently and cook only until done, as otherwise they lose both flavor and appearance.
When serving, arrange the chickens neatly on a platter and pour the sauce underneath.

Cut into the usual pieces and salt them, then let them rest in the salt for a quarter hour.
Pour good sour cream into a pot.
Cut a soup lemon thinly with its peel, carefully removing the seeds.
Layer half the lemon slices in the sour cream, then half the chicken pieces, then more sour cream.
Add the remaining lemon slices, then the rest of the chicken.
Top with sour cream and small pieces of butter.
Note: do not stir these chickens, only shake the pot gently and cook only until done, as otherwise they lose both flavor and appearance.
When serving, arrange the chickens neatly on a platter and pour the sauce underneath.

title: Csirke Vajas Mártásban Kartiflolával (Chicken in Butter Sauce with Cauliflower)
description: A sauce made with butter, cauliflower, and chickens.
steps: Prepare and blanch small chickens
Melt butter without making it hot
Add 2 tablespoons flour and lightly brown
Deglaze with good stock
Add 2 tablespoons sour cream and cook together well
Strain the sauce
Place the blanched chickens in the sauce and cook until sufficiently tender
Clean cauliflower and cook in salted water

Add the cauliflower to the sauce and cook together

Enrich the sauce with egg yolks (fricassée style) and pour over the chickens

title: Csirke Vér-Mártásban (Chicken in Blood Sauce)
description: A sauce made with chicken, vinegar, and bacon.
steps: When killing the chickens, collect the blood in a bowl with a small amount of vinegar
Mix the blood with the vinegar so it does not coagulate
Pluck and clean the chickens and salt them well
Place bacon pieces in a pot
Cut red onion in half and place in the center
Pierce each piece with three cloves
Add a few whole peppercorns and cloves
Add the chicken pieces and braise but do not allow them to brown
Remove the chicken pieces
Dust with 2 tablespoons flour and brown
Deglaze with liquid and reduce
Add a small amount of lemon juice and cook well
Strain through a sieve
Return the chicken pieces and cook until tender
Mix the blood with the sauce and cook together for a few minutes more

title: Csokoládé-fánk habos tejjel töltve (Chocolate Fritters Filled with Foamy Whipped Cream)
description: Prepared with whipped cream, sugar, and eggs.
steps: Put 28 dekagramm finely ground sugar into a brass bowl
Beat 12 whole eggs over it and beat well with the whisk
Place over gentle charcoal heat and beat continuously until the mixture becomes thick and white, handling the heat carefully so the mixture does not boil
When thick and white, remove from heat and beat a while longer
With the flat side of a cooking spoon, stir in 19 dekagramm fine flour
Fill a piping bag with the mixture and pipe small carnival fritter-sized drops onto white paper
Sprinkle with finely ground sugar
Place on a baking sheet and bake at gentle heat until beautiful and crispy
Once baked, carefully remove from the sheet
Fill with whipped cream that has been prepared beforehand with sugar and vanilla
Stack them two by two so they form a fritter shape
Arrange on a plate lined with a kitchen cloth
Serve quickly to the table
These fritters can also be filled with ice cream or strawberry foam

title: Csokoládé-szeletek (Chocolate Slices)
description: Prepared with chocolate, almonds, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams finely ground and sifted sugar
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams finely ground and sifted sugar

steps: Finely grind the softened almonds, moistening several times during grinding to prevent it from becoming oily
Cook the grated chocolate with three tablespoons water in a brass pan with continuous stirring into a thick paste
Beat butter until fluffy, finely grind the sugar
Mix the almonds and chocolate with the butter and sugar, stirring together for a good quarter hour
Fold in the stiff foam of seven egg whites
Spread the mixture thinly on a buttered baking sheet to pinky-finger thickness and bake slowly
Prepare a second mixture: beat granulated and sifted sugar rubbed with orange zest with four egg yolks for a quarter hour
Lightly fold in the stiff foam of four egg whites with 14 dekagrams fine flour
Meanwhile, melt 14 dekagrams butter, discard the whey, and when cooled, slowly fold in, stirring only until combined
Spread this mixture on a buttered baking sheet to pinky-finger thickness, sprinkle with sugar, and bake slowly
Once the second mixture is baked and cooled, cut into card-sized pieces
Spread the chocolate layer with peach marmalade and top with a white layer of the same size
Continue until all are filled
Mix 7 dekagrams finely ground and sifted sugar with {{source-13}} into icing
Fill a paper cone with a pinhead-sized opening with this icing
Decorate the slices and let dry

title: Csokoládé-torta (Chocolate Cake)
description: A cake made with chocolate, almonds, and egg yolks.
steps: Clean the almonds with cloth and crush them finely with their skins, pass through a fine sieve; crush what remains again, pass through the sieve and repeat until all is sifted
Crush 42 grams of sugar with a little vanilla and sift it together with 5 grams of crumbly crumbs, then mix everything together
Cook 28 grams of finely crushed chocolate with a cup of water in a brass pan with continuous stirring until it becomes completely smooth and child-porridge thick, then set aside
Put the almonds, sugar and crumbs into 17 grams of butter beaten until foamy, add 1 whole egg and 15 egg yolks, stir for half an hour
Now add the cooled chocolate and stir it in, then gently fold in the stiff foam of 7 egg whites
Butter two equal pans and fill each with half the mixture
Bake at gentle but sustained heat for three-quarters of an hour
Test with a knitting needle inserted into the bottom; if it comes out dry, the cake is baked; then cool the cake for a few minutes
Place one part of the cake on a appropriately sized cake leaf, fill with preserved peaches or raspberries, place the other cake on top and cover with chocolate glaze as found in the following recipe

Bake at gentle but sustained heat for three-quarters of an hour
Test with a knitting needle inserted into the bottom; if it comes out dry, the cake is baked; then cool the cake for a few minutes
Place one part of the cake on a appropriately sized cake leaf, fill with preserved peaches or raspberries, place the other cake on top and cover with chocolate glaze as found in the following recipe

title: Csokoládés Szilva (Chocolate-Covered Fried Plums)
description: Prepared with plums, chocolate, and fat.
steps: Wash the dried plums and scald without cooking them soft
When cooled and dried well, remove the pit
Place in hot fat and shake the pan continuously to fry quickly until crisp
Do not leave on heat too long as they burn easily
Grate three tablets of chocolate finely and mix with ten decagrams powdered sugar
As soon as the plums are removed from the pan and cleaned of fat, place in the chocolate mixture
Stir well with a spoon until completely coated
Heap high in the center of a platter
Cut out the core from sixteen to twenty apple slices with a small cutter
Dip in common pastry dough and fry quickly in hot fat
Let fat drip well and sprinkle heavily with powdered sugar until completely white
Place a candied cherry with stem in the opening in the center of each apple slice
Arrange apple slices around the edge of the platter

title: Csokoládéöntés torták és kisebb sütemények bevonására (Chocolate Glaze for Cakes and Smaller Pastries)
description: A cake made with chocolate, sugar, and water.
steps: Coarsely crush 21 grams of fine chocolate with 18 grams of sugar and cook in a sugar pan with 2 deciliters of water with continuous stirring until it boils with large bubbles and becomes light child-porridge thickness
Remove from heat and stir quickly, continuously and as long as for punch preserve until it passes the test, that is, until a drop dripped on paper does not spread but hardens
Place the cake on a sheet of paper, pour the glaze evenly over it, quickly spread what runs down onto the sides of the cake so that it is completely covered and let it stand for a few hours

Decorate with whole fruits or in the following way: mix finely 1 spoonful of beautiful yellow peach syrup with 2 teaspoons of crushed sugar, fill this into a small syringe and when the chocolate or lemon coating has hardened, press either arches or star shapes onto it
These decorations can be made in two colors, that is with yellow peach and red raspberry syrup

description: Prepared with pike, anchovies, and onion.

ingredients.name: large pike, about two kilograms in the middle

steps: Salt a large middle piece of pike and let it stand for an hour.
Dry the fish with a clean cloth.
Chop finely together eight anchovies, one red onion, fresh parsley, and one lemon zest, add a little pepper and mix well.

Place in a baking pan, pour three deciliters of sour cream over it, add the juice of one lemon, several pieces of butter and a handful of breadcrumbs.
Place coals on top and cook well.
Serve on a plate and pour the sauce over it.

title: Csuka szardellával tűzve (Pike Larded with Anchovies)
description: Prepared with pike, anchovies, and sour cream.
steps: Clean the pike in the usual way, fillet it and wash it thoroughly and salt it only very lightly.
Clean the washed anchovies of their bones and chop them lengthwise like bacon and lard the pike with them in two rows.
Place a piece of butter in a pan, add three spoonfuls of sour cream and the juice of one lemon and baste the fish with this several times during cooking.

When cooked, place it on the serving dish, add another spoonful of sour cream and a small piece of butter to it, bring to a boil, pour it over the fish and sprinkle lengthwise chopped lemon peel over it.

title: Csuka vágott mártással (Pike with Chopped Sauce)
description: A sauce made with pike, capers, and anchovies.
steps: Cook a piece of pike in salted water, remove its bones and chop it finely together with capers and two anchovies.
Melt a piece of butter, add the chopped mixture together with a little ground black pepper and braise it well.
When braised, fill it up with clear pea broth and a little vinegar and bring it to a boil.
Clean and salt a whole pike, melt a piece of butter in a pan, place the fish in it and braise it until it is braised on all sides.
Pour the sauce with the chopped mixture over it and bring it to a slight boil.

title: Császár-Bábakalács (Emperor Babka Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, yeast, and sour cream.
steps: Mix 6 egg yolks one by one into 100 grams whipped butter, add little salt, {{source-3}}, {{source-4}}, 2 deciliters lukewarm sour cream into a pot and mix well
Set aside while the butter and egg are whipped, and wait until the yeast begins to work, then strain it and slowly mix into the butter
Then mix in so much flour that it becomes a light dough but does not flow, being rather like funnel-cake dough
When you have stirred until it pulls from the spoon, cover and let rise in a warm place
Meanwhile finely grind {{source-7}} cleaned with cloth with the skin, and well mix with the same amount of ground sugar and a little cinnamon, and chop {{source-10}} together

When the dough has risen, butter the mold, fill it with half the dough and smooth it with a spoon dipped in flour, sprinkle evenly with the almond and sugar mixture, sprinkle the raisins on and cover with the rest of the dough, set in a warm place
When well risen, bake at gentle but lasting heat, turn onto a sieve and finely sprinkle with ground sugar

title: Császár-pudding (Emperor Pudding)
description: A pudding made with almonds, citron, and egg yolks.
steps: Whip 9 dekagrams butter until fluffy

Turn onto a plate and pour wine sauce around it

title: Curd Cheese Cake with Crumbly Dough (Túrós-lepény omlós tésztából)
description: Prepared with fat or butter, yeast, and egg yolks.
steps: To {{source-0}} add 3/8 fat or butter and rub together well
Soak 2 dekagrams yeast in 1/2 coffee cup milk with three pieces of sugar to let it rise
With 4 egg yolks, 1/2 coffee cup wine, proper salt and the yeast, quickly knead a soft dough - if kneaded too long it becomes tough and hard, not crumbly
Let it rest for a few hours; when it has rested and appears to have risen, flatten it in a pan to the thickness of a knife blade, or slightly thicker
Force the curd cheese through thick cloth to remove the whey, then place in a bowl
With 2 egg yolks, a few spoonfuls of sweet sour cream, a piece of butter the size of an egg, and beaten foam from the 2 egg whites, mix the curd cheese together

ingredients.sourceText: 10 dekagrams of the finest currants or raspberries

steps: Clean and wash 10 dekagrams of the finest currants or raspberries and dry them on a sieve
At the moment of placing the cake in the oven, fold the fruit into the batter, pour into the butter-greased pan, and immediately place in the oven to prevent the fruit from sinking to the bottom
For lighter fruits like raspberries this method works well, but for heavy cherries it is difficult

Press out 7 decilitres of juice from the fruit and cook it with 14 dekagrams sugar until thick, cool it, turn the cake out onto a plate, and coat it with the syrup, which should have the appearance of light jelly
This cake can be made either baked in a pan or in a baker's oven

title: Czukorral bevont gesztenye (Glazed Chestnuts)
description: Prepared with chestnuts, sugar, and water.
steps: Roast the large Italian chestnuts until the shells can be cleanly removed
Cook the broken sugar with half a cup of water until it becomes caramel (raw sugar), as one would cook it when making sugar tablets

Test if the caramel is ready by dipping a thin stick first in cold water then in the boiling sugar and again in cold water; the sugar should break cleanly and not be sticky, otherwise the chestnut will stick to the teeth
Once the sugar is properly cooked, dip the shelled chestnuts one by one into it
Place on a stone where they will become beautifully glass-like
Arrange immediately in the familiar boxes

title: Czukortorta (Sugar Cake)
description: A cake made with sugar, powdered sugar, and lemon.

ingredients.name: zest of one lemon, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: zest of one lemon, finely chopped

steps: Mix together butter, flour, powdered sugar, vanilla, lemon zest, and hard-boiled sieved egg yolks well
Place butter in the center and work together with a rolling pin
Add 3 egg yolks and cream as needed to moisten the dough
Combine the dough with a broad knife; the dough should not be stiff
Roll out the dough to the thickness of a little finger
Cut three equal layers from it and bake them nicely, then cool
Spread jam on each layer, assemble them together, and cover with lemon glaze
For the glaze: place 24 dekagrams sugar (rubbed lightly on lemon then finely powdered and sieved) in a bowl
Add juice of half a lemon and a little egg yolk and stir continuously
If the glaze is not thin enough, add more juice and stir for half an hour
When well foamed, cover the cake with it
In a cooled oven, slowly dry the glaze

description: Prepared with semolina, raisins, and milk.

ingredients.name: one and one-quarter decilitres of fine semolina
ingredients.sourceText: one and one-quarter decilitres of fine semolina

steps: Four hours before use, soak one and one-quarter decilitres of fine semolina in seven decilitres of milk, then set aside
Beat five whole eggs with two decilitres of milk and vanilla sifted with sugar, then mix with the soaked semolina
Melt fourteen dekagrams of butter in a wide shallow pan, pour the mixture into it with a little salt and braise it to a beautiful golden yellow
You can also add fourteen dekagrams of raisins during the braising
Serve the porridge immediately as it loses much of its quality from prolonged warming
Heap it high on the plate, sprinkling each layer well with sugar

title: Dinnye eczetben (Melon in Vinegar)
description: Prepared with melon, vinegar, and sugar.
steps: Peel the melon and cut into slices, place in a basin.
For each 500 grams of melon, cook 1.5 liters vinegar with 80 dekagrams sugar and pour over the melon.
Repeat this process.
On the third day, cook the vinegar with the melon together, then remove it and pack in a jar with cloves and cinnamon.
Cook the vinegar carefully with frequent skimming until slightly reduced and pour hot over the melon slices.
If the vinegar becomes thin again after a few days, cook it once more.

title: Disznófej-sajt (Pork Head Cheese)
description: Prepared with pork, onion, and lemon.

ingredients.name: 4-5 pieces of fresh pork skin, palm-sized
ingredients.sourceText: 4-5 pieces of fresh pork skin, palm-sized

ingredients.name: a few spoonfuls thin red blood
ingredients.sourceText: a few spoonfuls thin red blood

steps: Boil the fresh pork head and fresh pork skin until tender
Let cool until half-cold, then remove meat from bones
Cut meat into long, thin slices and the pork skin into thin strips
Salt appropriately and gently mix the meat with skin so they do not break
Finely chop the parboiled red onion and squeeze lemon juice into it, grate in the zest
Add a little paprika, abundant black and clove pepper
Add a few spoonfuls of thin red blood to achieve a nice dark color
Gently fold everything together, stirring slowly so as not to break the meat and skin, until evenly colored and flavored throughout
Fill the cleaned stomach casing well with the mixture
Boil in hot salted water for half an hour
Pierce with a thin needle; if clear fat rather than red liquid comes out, it is done
Remove and press flat while warm
Either smoke it or use it fresh; dry in air for twenty-four hours for additional flavor

title: Dobos torta (Dobos Cake)
description: A cake made with egg whites, egg yolks, and chocolate.

ingredients.name: creamy butter for the mold and flour for dusting
ingredients.sourceText: creamy butter for the mold and flour for dusting

steps: Beat four egg whites into half-stiff foam and mix in seven dekagrams of sugar.
Rub together seven dekagrams of sugar with five egg yolks until foamy.
Add ten dekagrams of flour to the egg yolk mixture.
Fold in the beaten egg whites.
Coat the cake mold with creamy butter and dust with flour.
Spread a knife's-thickness layer of the batter onto the mold and bake. Six to seven layers can be made from the given quantity.
For the filling: rub fourteen dekagrams of butter until foamy.
Cook twenty-eight dekagrams of sugar into syrup.
Add to the foamy butter fourteen dekagrams of dissolved and cooled chocolate, four egg yolks, and a little vanilla.
When the sugar syrup is also cooled, add it to the butter and mix together.
When the entire mixture is completely cooled, spread it on the sponge layers, placing a second layer on each coated layer.
For the icing: caramelize fourteen dekagrams of broken sugar to golden color and pour it over the top of the finished cake, smoothing it with a blunt knife.

title: Dödölle (Millet Porridge)
description: Prepared with pork fat, sour cream, and cheese.

ingredients.name: one and a half litres hot salted water
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half litres hot salted water

steps: Cook the well-rinsed millet porridge in one and a half litres of hot salted water, stirring constantly to prevent burning, until it is so thick that the cooking spoon stands in it
Tear this into haluska-sized pieces, place them around the edge of a large bowl to cool so it keeps its shape
Once cooled, move them from the bowl's edge to the center with a knife, and always place new ones on the edge until all are torn
In another pot, melt seven dekagrams of pork fat, add two decilitres of good sour cream, pour this hot over the haluska, top with crumbled salty cheese, and shake the whole thing well

title: Egész baraczkot befőzni (Whole Preserved Apricots)
description: Prepared with apricots, sugar, and water.
steps: The apricots must not be completely ripe, but hard and yellowish.
Wash the apricots and dry them with cloth.
Cut them in half in the middle and place them in sugar.
Bring to a boil three times on all sides, so they do not soften and their skin remains intact.
Remove them with a silver spoon, cool them, and pour the syrup over them; the glass remains open.
After twenty-four hours, strain the syrup, bring it to a boil again, and pour it slightly warmer over the fruit.
Repeat this for three days; on the fourth day, boil the syrup again until it thickens, cool it, and pour it over.
On the fifth day, tie the glass closed.

title: Egész spanyol-meggyet befőzni (Preserved Whole Cherries)
description: Prepared with cherries, sugar, and water.
steps: Boil 500 grams of sugar with one glass of water, removing the scum during boiling so it is completely clear, and boil until it throws heavy drops.

Then add 500 grams of the most beautiful type of cherry, having trimmed half of the stem, do not stir it with a spoon, but shake the pan several times so it mixes well with the sugar, and boil for a quarter hour.
Then remove the cherries with a slotted spoon and boil the juice for another quarter hour.
When removing from the fire, place the cherries back into it, and handle as you would other preserved items when filling.

title: Elfort élesztője (Elfort Yeast)
description: Prepared with barley, beer, and water.
steps: Pour one part of finely ground barley malt into a barrel
Add three parts of boiling water and stir for a while, then close the vessel with a lid
After standing for two hours, pour off the liquid from the malt
Boil for three hours
Pour back into the barrel and when cooled, add one sixteenth part of good beer yeast
After several days, fermentation is complete and the yeast has settled
If a small amount of surface yeast appears, remove it and later mix with the bottom yeast
Pour the prepared yeast into bottles; after 24 hours, pour off the liquid, cover the yeast with cold water, plug the bottles, and keep them in a vessel filled with cold water

title: Emperor's Crumbs (Császármorzsóka)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, sour cream, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams sugar, rubbed with lemon and ground
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams sugar, rubbed with lemon and ground

steps: Into 7 dekagrams of fluffy beaten butter, gradually mix 6 egg yolks and then 8 spoonfuls of sour cream, one spoonful at a time
Add 7 dekagrams of sugar rubbed with lemon, a little salt, and 6 spoonfuls of fine flour
Finally, when well mixed, add the stiff snow from 6 egg whites
Pour the batter into a buttered baking dish
Bake in the oven until golden yellow
Break up with two knives
Heap high on a plate and serve dusted with sugar

Alternatively, for Emperor's Boats: place the batter in a buttered baking dish, bake until light yellow, cut into diagonal cubes with a sharp knife and make a cross-cut on top, fry until golden in hot lard, fill the cut as desired with preserved fruit and serve dusted with sugar

When the consommé is solidified from braising, turn it out onto a clean board
Cut it with a dumpling cutter into crescent-shaped or round slices
Place the vegetables, the fried bread, and the consommé in a soup bowl
Pour brown broth over it

title: Fagylalt hálóköntösben (Ice Cream in a Nightgown)
description: Prepared with raspberry or cherry or currant or ice cream and vanilla.

ingredients.name: raspberry, sour cherry, or currant ice cream
ingredients.sourceText: raspberry, sour cherry, or currant ice cream

steps: Prepare vanilla ice cream and freeze it hard
In another mold, prepare raspberry, sour cherry, or currant ice cream and freeze it similarly; the vanilla ice cream mold should be only half full

Once frozen solid, repeatedly spread the ice cream on the inner sides of the mold, always taking the ice cream from the center so a deep hollow remains that does not reach the bottom, with the whole mold being newly coated in thickness

Remove 3 large spoonfuls of vanilla ice cream into an ice-chilled bowl, quickly fill the hollow with the liquid ice cream, spread it strongly and smoothly with a spoon, and cover the top with the removed vanilla ice cream
Close the mold, freshen the ice, and turn it rapidly in the ice for a quarter hour, drain the water well, cover the mold with ice, and leave it there until serving
Then quickly turn it out, cut into slices, and serve at once

title: Fasirozott csirke (Ground Chicken)
description: Prepared with chickens, bacon, and beef broth.
steps: After blanching beautiful meaty chickens, let them soak for a while in warm water until they turn white nicely.
Split them in half along the back and remove all the bones up to the wings and legs.
Cut the meat, membrane, and all stringy parts together with a little bacon into small pieces.
Grate and milk-soak half a roll, wring it out well, beat two eggs into it, and stir over the fire until it becomes thick.
Crush the meat together with the roll in a mortar until fine.
Add a little nutmeg flower and salt.
Dry the chickens with a cloth, pour one or two spoonfuls of beef broth over them.
Braise slowly for half an hour and prepare a little mushroom sauce for them.
When serving, remove the bacon from the chickens, place on a platter, and pour the sauce over them.

title: Fegyverfánk (Wafer Fritter)
description: Prepared with egg yolk, ground almonds, and cream.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagramm swollen and finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagramm swollen and finely ground almonds

steps: Beat 7 dekagramm butter foamy and slowly beat in 1 whole egg and 1 egg yolk
Mix in well 7 dekagramm swollen and finely ground almonds and 9 dekagramm ground sugar with vanilla
Add 4-5 tablespoons cream and finally 7 dekagramm fine flour mixed with the rest
Heat the wafer fritter iron on a flame, first coat with butter, wipe with paper, heat again
Place a small spoonful of dough on the iron, press the iron together well, turn several times over the fire so the dough is brownish-yellow on both sides
Quickly peel off with a knife and place in arch shape
Once all are baked, let sit in a warm place as they easily soften
Pile high on a plate and sprinkle with sugar

description: Prepared with jelly and chocolate.
steps: Prepare white jelly and pour into a flat rectangular dish
Place on ice and freeze completely
When well frozen, mark in advance and cut lengthwise six times and widthwise six times to form equal square cubes
Carefully remove every other cube with a spoon handle, leaving alternating cubes in place
Cook the removed cubes with 2 tablets of grated chocolate
When cooled, fill the empty spaces with the chocolate mixture
Return to ice and freeze again to form a checkerboard pattern

When well cooked, strain the sauce, add mushrooms, remove the bacon from the chickens, place it in the pot and bring to a boil once more.

ingredients.name: twenty-one dekagrams almonds (including several bitter ones)
ingredients.sourceText: twenty-one dekagrams almonds (including several bitter ones)

steps: Prepare four deciliters of strong coffee and sweeten well
Mix in three dekagrams of dissolved isinglass
When the coffee is clear and well mixed with the isinglass, strain through table linen
Pour into a melon-shaped mold in alternating sections: first fill one section, when frozen, fill another section of the mold, place on ice until frozen, and continue alternating
Prepare almond milk by making a milk from twenty-one dekagrams of almonds (including a few bitter ones) with four deciliters of water
Sweeten the almond milk well and mix in two dekagrams of isinglass
Strain once more
When the coffee in the mold is well frozen, slowly pour in the almond milk to fill the mold
Place on ice and freeze
When unmolding, work quickly and carefully so the coffee does not mix with the almond milk, keeping the sections in their own colors, one white and one black

title: Finom Omlós Kifli (Fine Crumbly Croissant)
description: Prepared with fat, egg yolks, and yeast.
steps: Take {{source-0}} and {{source-1}}, and with half the flour mix the fat, little salt, knife-tip of ground clove, 1 coffee spoon ground cinnamon together with a pastry roller, and set aside one egg-sized piece of this dough, rolling it out to half a finger thickness and putting it in a cold place

With the remaining flour, 6 egg yolks, {{source-6}} dissolved in warm sugared water, and {{source-8}} and the egg-sized piece of fatty dough, knead a fine soft dough, working it for a long time until it becomes smooth and bubbly
Place in a warm location and let it rise well, then turn it onto a board and stretch it to the proper size, and fold in the cooled fatty dough, letting it rest for half an hour folded
Roll out three times at half-hour intervals, finally leaving it knife-edge thin
Sprinkle with sliced almonds, cinnamon sugar, and clove sugar
Cut into cubes with a hot knife and form croissants from the cubes, coat with egg, sprinkle almonds on top and bake quickly until nicely golden
It rises beautifully, fine and crumbly like puff pastry and layered

title: Fogoly-szálmi Pástétomkákkal (Partridge Forcemeat with Pâté Croquettes)
description: Prepared with partridge, partridges, and bacon.
steps: Salt three cleaned partridges and wrap them in thin bacon slices, then roast them.
Cut the breasts from two partridges; grind the remaining parts together with the third partridge and fried bread in a mortar until it becomes a paste.
Put this in a pot, add a ladle of good brown broth and half a cup of red wine, and simmer until cooked.
Cut the reserved partridge breasts into pieces and prepare a separate mixture.
Cut the breast meat into cubes; similarly prepare half a goose liver rolled in fine breadcrumbs and fried in fat.
Melt a little butter, add finely chopped green parsley and a little red onion; add the cut meat and liver with three to four spoonfuls of buttered gravy and reduce until thick.
Have the baker make small rolls the size of a coin; scrape the crust, cut a cover the size of a groschen from the top, and remove the inside, moistening with sour cream but not making it too soft.
Dip these rolls in beaten, salted egg and breadcrumbs, then fry golden in fat.
Arrange the rolls on a sieve to drain.
Push the forcemeat through a fine sieve onto the bottom of a dish, arrange the fried rolls in a circle, fill with the prepared mixture, and top with the lids.
Work as quickly as possible so the dish does not cool.

title: Franczia kétszersült (French Twice-Baked Biscuit)
description: A biscuit made with eggs, sugar, and flour.

ingredients.name: flour equal in weight to 7 whole eggs
ingredients.sourceText: flour equal in weight to 7 whole eggs

steps: Weigh 10 whole eggs with shells and measure the same weight of sifted sugar
Measure flour equal in weight to 7 whole eggs
Separate the whites from the yolks of the 10 eggs
Beat the egg whites into stiff foam
Place in a bowl and beat in the egg yolks, then the sugar
Stir for half an hour
Quickly mix in the measured dry flour, stirring only until well combined
Coat the sheet mold with a little butter
Pour in the dough
Sprinkle the top with sifted sugar
Bake in a gentle oven for 10-12 minutes
Cut into slices of knife-blade thickness
Return to the oven and toast lightly
French sponge cake can also be made from this dough

title: Franezia leveles torta (French Puff Pastry Cake)
description: A cake made with puff pastry, apricots, and currants.

ingredients.name: five-times folded puff pastry made from approximately eighty dekagrams of butter
ingredients.sourceText: five-times folded puff pastry made from approximately eighty dekagrams of butter

steps: Prepare five-times folded puff pastry from approximately eighty dekagrams of butter
Roll the pastry in three layers to the thickness of two knife-backs
Cut out two completely equal round leaves with a warm knife, sized as a 38 dekagram pastry leaf
Cut out a large circle from the center with a large doughnut cutter, leaving only a hand-width-sized smooth edge
Cut out two more completely identical leaves and cut them the same way, continuing until eight pairs are made, with each pair being about half a small finger-width smaller than the other
Brush every leaf with beaten egg, prick with a knife point, dust with finely ground sugar, and bake in a slightly cooled oven
Once baked, coat the largest leaf with cooked apricots to a knife-back thickness and place its pair on top
Fill the second pair with apricots and continue until all eight pairs are filled

Coat the edges of the joined leaves with foamy icing made from four egg whites to a knife-back thickness and roll over finely chopped pistachios on rice paper so the entire edge appears green with powder
Coat the second leaf similarly and roll it in coarsely ground sugar, the third again in pistachios, and so on until all eight pairs are powdered
Return to a cooled oven only until the foamy icing is dried, with the sugar remaining completely white and the pistachios a nice green

Once cooled, place the first two joined leaves on the intended plate, coat with cooked apricots, place the second double leaf on top so it occupies exactly the center of the first, coat its surface again with apricots and place the third leaf on top, continuing until all eight are stacked on top of each other
Decorate the final leaf with cooked whole cherries

title: Friss cseresnyés torta (Fresh Cherry Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, powdered sugar, and lemon.
steps: Beat nine egg yolks with nine spoonfuls of powdered sugar and lemon juice until it thickens and becomes foamy
Finely chop quarter kilogram of blanched almonds and divide in half
Mix half into the egg yolk mixture
Add the grated zest of one whole lemon, one teaspoon of ground cinnamon, and a knife-point of ground cloves
Whip nine egg whites into stiff peaks
Add the sifted crumbs of two crispy rolls and fold in the meringue
Pour into a buttered and floured baking pan
Bake in moderate heat in the oven
Pit {{source-11}}
When the cake has formed a crust on top, sprinkle the cherries on it and return to bake
The heavy cherries will sink partway into the soft dough
When the cake is done, whip four to six egg whites into stiff peaks
Sweeten well with sugar and coat the top of the cake with it, one finger thickness
Sprinkle the remaining ground almonds on top
When the meringue has turned golden, place on a sieve so the bottom does not soften

title: Fáczán Angol Módra (Pheasant English Style)
description: Prepared with pheasant, lard, and ham.
steps: Bone the pheasant while keeping it whole, stuff it, and restore it to its original shape.
Wrap it in paper with lard, ham, and lemon peel, and place on a buttered pot lid.
Put it in the oven.
To prepare the sauce: warm a small amount of butter in a pot, add ham and finely chopped mushrooms, sprinkle in a small amount of flour, and pour brown stock over it.
Simmer briefly, skim off the fat, and add lemon juice to make it tart.
Pour this sauce under the pheasant when serving.

title: Fánk Mandola-Tejből (Fritter with Almond Milk)
description: Prepared with milk, blanched almonds, and breadcrumbs.
steps: Grind the soaked almonds fine and place in a soup bowl
Pour 5 deciliters water over it and let stand for an hour with frequent stirring
Wring out in a cloth and pound the almonds again, pour the almond milk over it, mix well and strain a second time for a strong almond milk
Mix in enough sugar so the taste is distinctly sweet
In a pot slowly mix {{source-3}} with the almond milk, cook to a smooth paste with continuous stirring
When well cooked, spread on buttered sheet metal to finger thickness, cool and carefully turn onto a flour-dusted board
Cut out in crescent shapes with a flour-dusted cutter, brush with beaten egg and coat with fine breadcrumbs
Fry in fat to a beautiful golden color and dust with powdered sugar

For a more elegant presentation, make the following fritter to combine with it: in a pot set over low heat, slowly mix 4 deciliters milk with {{source-7}}, 4 grated tablets chocolate and {{source-9}} with continuous stirring
Cook until thick and smooth, then cool
Spread the paste evenly on buttered parchment with a knife moistened in water, cool completely, heat the parchment for a moment, then carefully turn onto a flour-dusted board and cut into crescents
Brush with egg and coat half with flour and half with breadcrumbs
Fry in hot fat and dust densely with finely grated chocolate
Arrange the white almond milk fritters and chocolate fritters alternately on a platter and serve

title: Főzött dararétes (Boiled Semolina Strudel)
description: Prepared with semolina, sour cream, and flour.

ingredients.name: two whole eggs and three egg yolks
ingredients.sourceText: two whole eggs and three egg yolks

steps: From twenty-eight dekagramm flour, one egg, and a little lukewarm water, prepare firm strudel dough
While it rests, beat 7 dekagramm butter until fluffy
Add two whole eggs and three egg yolks to it and mix well
Once finely mixed, add four decziliters sour cream and three decziliters semolina
Stretch the dough very thinly
Brush the filling halfway across it and fold it together
Using a wooden spoon handle dusted with flour, make indentations at equal distances and cut with a knife in two
Press the ends together well with your fingers
Boil the strudel pieces in hot water, but only until they float through, otherwise they will fall apart
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle each piece with finely chopped bread rolls fried in butter

title: Fűszer-torta (Spice Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, lemon, and orange.

ingredients.name: 42 dekagramm almonds with skin, finely ground
ingredients.sourceText: 42 dekagramm almonds with skin, finely ground

ingredients.name: zest of half an orange, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: zest of half an orange, finely chopped

steps: Mix together the finely ground sugar and almonds with skin, finely chopped lemon and orange zest, ground cinnamon with cloves
On a board, knead the mixture with egg white using a large knife into a firm dough, being careful not to make it too soft or liquid
Sprinkle the board and dough with finely ground sugar and roll out to the thickness of a finger
Cut three equal sheets from it and place on a baking sheet greased with butter or wax
On one of the sheets before baking, press a lattice from Spanish puff paste using a pastry bag, as is customary for Linz torte
The dough for this must be quite firm and should be mixed with sugar and vanilla just as for puff cake dough
Around the edge of the sheet press small Spanish puff pastries so that the lattice perimeter forms a wreath shape
When the sheets have dried and the lattice has hardened, fill each with different preserves and stack them
Place the lattice on top, sprinkle with sugar, and arrange with preserved fruit
Bake slowly in a cooled oven until dry

title: Galamb béliéivé (Stuffed Pigeon)
description: Prepared with pigeon, marrow, and bread.

ingredients.name: several shelled and diced crayfish tails
ingredients.sourceText: several shelled and diced crayfish tails

steps: After cleaning and soaking the pigeon in water, cut it open along the back and remove the meat all the way to the head, legs and wings
Finely chop this meat together with a little marrow, finely chopped parsley, lemon zest, bread soaked in milk, and a mixture made from two eggs
Place in a bowl, then add two whole eggs, a full tablespoon of sour cream, and several shelled crayfish tails diced into cubes
Stuff the pigeons with this mixture and sew them shut so they regain their former shape
Place bacon, red onion, and carrots cut into slices in a pot, place the pigeons on top
Cover with oil-brushed paper and a lid and braise well, frequently pouring a little broth over them so the pigeons do not dry out
Remove the pigeons and braise the vegetables left in the pot until nicely brown
Sprinkle a little flour over them, dilute with good broth and cook down
Strain the sauce through a sieve, place the pigeons back in and serve on the table

title: Gelée narancsból (Orange Jelly)
description: Prepared with oranges, lemons, and white wine.
steps: Place the finely chopped sugar in a bowl, add the finely peeled zest from one orange, and let stand covered until the sugar is dissolved
Meanwhile, squeeze the juice from the oranges and lemons and strain together as described above
Combine the strained liquid with the lukewarm aspic, wine and sugar
Color the jelly red with cochineal or other coloring
Strain through a cloth, test for firmness, pour into the mold and freeze

To garnish with orange shells: hollow out the orange skins and scrape off the inner white side well, beat some of the orange jelly until white and foamy, fill the shells with this, once frozen cut into quarters and use to surround the jelly

Alternatively, segment the oranges like a compote, peel and remove the seeds, then marinate with sugar, pour a little orange jelly into the mold, freeze it, arrange a layer of orange segments on top, then jelly, continuing in layers until the mold is full

title: Gelée pezsgőből (Champagne Jelly)
description: Prepared with juice, isinglass or aspic, and sugar.

ingredients.name: 6 dekagramm isinglass or equivalent amount of aspic
ingredients.sourceText: 6 dekagramm isinglass or equivalent amount of aspic

steps: Combine the cooled sugar with the lukewarm aspic, strained lemon juice and champagne
Strain through a cloth
After testing the firmness of the jelly, place one quarter of the mixture in a porcelain vessel and set it on ice
Beat the remaining jelly with a whisk until it becomes white, foamy and begins to thicken
Fill the mold one quarter full with this beaten mixture
Once the beaten mass has almost completely frozen, pour the remaining strained jelly over it and completely freeze the whole on ice

To imitate champagne bubbles, combine the sugar with lemon juice, aspic and one quarter of the champagne and stir on ice until it begins to thicken, then slowly pour in the remaining champagne by spoonfuls, creating foam bubbles in the jelly, then pour into the mold and freeze on ice
